resources.string: Immediately request pause for all playing or buffering media sessions when a USB disconnect event is received.\n\nEnable notification access before first use. This app monitors USB connection and accessory removal events without reading notification content. There is no added delay; even brief USB re-enumeration may pause playback, and reconnecting does not resume it. Already paused players are left unchanged; a failing player does not block others. This applies to all USB data connections, not just Deskflow sessions.
Status: Media control access enabled. USB disconnect events immediately request pause.
